# Preview a running feature `PRF`

[As built](../README.md) › Preview a running feature

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a reviewer open, check the status of, and stop a feature's running preview app in the browser, reaching into the sealed network through the doorway forwarder.
